high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Sabrina Carpenter, as indicated by the username "sabrinacarpenter" at the top left corner. The post was made 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The main content of the post is a photograph of Madison Square Garden at night. The building is illuminated with bright lights, and the iconic Madison Square Garden signage is prominently displayed on the right side of the building. A large screen on the facade of the building shows a red lipstick kiss mark, adding a playful element to the scene.
